values.note: 60 water/electric sites in an oak hammock, in two loops. Reserve Florida lists 54 bookable units (one tent-only), all back-in, with per-site limits of 25 to 45 ft although the park page says 55 ft. Primitive equestrian, backpacking and youth group sites are separate. The park page warns that boating noise from the lake can carry through the campground on holiday weekends.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-kissimmee-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Sixty campsites', 'Maximum recreational vehicle length is 55 feet', 'on holiday weekends, boating noise from Lake Kissimmee can be heard throughout the campground') + Reserve Florida search/details for facilities 99 and 100 (VehicleLength 25-45, PullInTypeName: all Back In), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-kissimmee-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 60 water/electric sites, 30-amp on every bookable unit, RVs to 55 ft (park page; 45 ft the longest per-site limit), all back-in, showers and a dump station, reservable 11 months ahead. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; units still $20 + utility). Sewer, laundry, fcfs, season and stay limits not stated. Note unchanged.
